title: Entanglement orchestration and failure model
description: Compare application contracts, candidate routes, resource reservation, control-channel security, and failure behavior.
modelNote: All route values are illustrative teaching inputs, not measurements of a deployed network. The model applies an exponential visibility loss while a pair waits, then checks explicit capacity, fidelity, deadline, memory, and control-integrity gates.

requests.label: Remote state transfer
requests.detail: One end-to-end pair with moderate quality and a bounded response time.

requests.label: Distributed gate burst
requests.detail: Four pairs must be available together before the oldest one decoheres.

requests.label: Synchronized sensing round
requests.detail: A stricter fidelity target with limited tolerance for scheduling jitter.

routes.label: Short, scarce route
routes.detail: Two links with strong quality but only two pair slots.

routes.label: Multiplexed detour
routes.detail: Three links and more memories trade path length for concurrent capacity.

routes.label: Direct but fragile
routes.detail: No swap stage, low pair-generation yield, and a short memory window.

schedulingPolicies.label: End-to-end reservation
schedulingPolicies.detail: Reserve memories and pair slots before generation; pay setup latency for a coherent contract.

schedulingPolicies.label: Opportunistic best effort
schedulingPolicies.detail: Start on available links without a complete reservation; contention reduces usable capacity.

schedulingPolicies.label: Priority with preemption
schedulingPolicies.detail: Reclaim a bounded share for urgent work, leaving less deterministic capacity for other requests.

failures.label: Healthy control and links
failures.detail: Use the route's baseline generation, memory, and signalling assumptions.

failures.label: Photon-loss spike
failures.detail: Elementary generation slows and the accepted detections carry less confidence.

failures.label: Memory lifetime collapse
failures.detail: Noise and contention reduce the useful storage window to one quarter.

failures.label: Delayed herald replay
failures.detail: An old success notification arrives during a newer reservation.

failures.label: Forged swap command
failures.detail: An attacker attempts to bind a pair or operation to the wrong reservation.

securityModes.label: Authenticated and freshness-bound
securityModes.detail: Verify controller identity, authorization, reservation ID, monotonic sequence, and expiry.

securityModes.label: Authenticated without freshness
securityModes.detail: Verify the sender but permit an old signed herald or command to be replayed.

securityModes.label: Unsigned control messages
securityModes.detail: Trust network location and pair identifiers without cryptographic origin or replay checks.
